notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Please go to the nearest emergency department or labour and delivery unit now — have someone else drive you rather than driving yourself, and call 911 if you feel faint or cannot get there quickly. If you have a seizure, someone with you should call 911 immediately. A lasting headache with blurry vision and facial and hand swelling in late pregnancy can signal a serious blood-pressure problem needing urgent checks of you and your baby. I recommend Counsel stay involved after you are seen.
